newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Rubber shortage pushes Colombo prices up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Rubber shortage pushes Colombo prices up sharply.

text.p: A shortage of rubber because of holidays and rain which interrupted tapping drove prices sharply higher at the Colombo auction on Friday, brokers said.
"There was a lot of demand today and a very small quantity on offer," said a broker at brokerage John Keells. "The market moved up by about two rupees."
There was firm interest from all buyers and prices for all grades of crepe moved up, said a broker at Forbes and Walker.
"Prices are likely to stay firm till the end of July when the real crops start coming in," he said.
